name: cascade-shield-ai
description: CascadeShield AI is an intelligent, auditable, enterprise-grade cloud resilience platform providing virtual digital twin modeling, dependency mapping, AI-based anomaly detection, cascading failure blast radius simulation, evidence-grounded root cause analysis (RCA), adaptive diagnostic agents, what-if scenario simulations, intelligent recovery planning with risk assessment, automated recovery validation, and resilience benchmarking with repeatable failure evaluation across standard baselines.
